mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.6% signals weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 7.6% or the unemployment rate's rise is not sustained beyond the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) creates conflicting signals, but persistent inflation dominates, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive despite the interaction, or the inflation rate does not sustain a rising trend alongside low rates.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 104.0 signals robust supply-side momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not sustain the rise beyond the trigger period, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in federal funds rate above 4% predicts higher interest rates, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4%, or the tightening cycle does not materialize as expected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong demand, driving investor confidence and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive, or GDP growth reverses before the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signal robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive, or the proxies do not move in tandem as expected.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 7.5% predicts peak demand and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE exceeding 7.5%, or the unemployment rate's rise is not sustained beyond the trigger period.
